item.title: Self-Hosted ClickHouse HTTP Proxy & Load Balancing: CHProxy vs Traefik vs Nginx (2026)
item.description: ClickHouse is one of the fastest open-source columnar databases for real-time analytics, but as query volume grows, a single ClickHouse instance becomes a bottleneck. HTTP proxy and load balancing solutions distribute queries across multiple ClickHouse servers, manage connection pooling, enforce rate limits, and provide a single entry point for client applications.
